create_gpt2: create a dictionary of GPT-2 model tensors with specified number of transformer layers using paddle
test_paddle_paddle_load: test paddle.load benchmark by saving and loading GPT-2 weights with paddle.save and paddle.load
test_paddle_sf_load: test safetensors load_file benchmark by saving and loading GPT-2 weights with save_file and load_file
build_save_gpt2_weights: build a function to save GPT-2 model weights to a file using safetensors save_file
build_load_gpt2_weights: build a function to load GPT-2 model weights from a file using safetensors load_file
